column1: # NEBNext Multiplex Oligos for Illumina — Dual Index Primers Set 1 (NEB #E7600S)
# Source: NEB instruction manual "manualE7600", version 6.0_6/24. Extracted 2026-07-31.
# 8 x i5 index primers (i501-i508) + 12 x i7 index primers (i701-i712) = 96 combinations.
# Primer backbones (index substituted at [i5]/[i7]; *T = 3' phosphorothioate bond):
# Adapter trim (NEBNext):  Read1 AGATCGGAAGAGCACACGTCTGAACTCCAGTCA   Read2 AGATCGGAAGAGCGTCGTGTAGGGAAAGAGTGT
# ORIENTATION (critical for demux / matching to reads):
#   * i7 index read is workflow-INDEPENDENT = reverse-complement of the in-primer index (the read_fwd/read_revcomp columns are identical for i7).
#       - Forward-Strand Workflow (index = in-primer seq): NovaSeq6000 v1.0, MiniSeq rapid, MiSeq, HiSeq2000/2500, HiSeq3000/4000 single-read
#       - Reverse-Complement Workflow (index = RC): iSeq100, MiniSeq std, NextSeq, NovaSeq6000 v1.5, HiSeq2000/2500 single-read, HiSeq3000/4000 paired-end
# These are the E7600 Set-1 kit indexes; they are DISTINCT from the standard TruSeq/observed windows (CCGATGGTCTCT / GTAGATCGGCTC).
